validation_scope: fixed-five batched retrieval and joint 2048-token budget

hard_rules.dependencies: new cycles require phase bindings; no exposure-specific default may select Base, corpus, seed, eval or run paths
hard_rules.source: recipe SHA, source manifest and stage source closure must be hash-valid before execution
hard_rules.base: must be a frozen hash-valid Base release
hard_rules.data: SFT release and eval lock must be immutable and quality-approved
hard_rules.index: rebuild after any LM or retrieval-head change
hard_rules.thresholds: validation scope only; locked test never tunes thresholds
hard_rules.q4: diagnostic branch only; CQ2 remains the product mainline
hard_rules.score_failure: complete independent diagnostics and mark release ineligible
hard_rules.integrity_failure: block immediately on identity, hash or contamination failure
